title: The 2 Best Woodworking Vise 2026
metaDescription: Our 2 picks for woodworking vise 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at woodworking vise 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Eclipse Quick Release Woodworking Vise, Gray Cast Iron, 10-Inch
products.blurb: Key specs: 9-inch jaw width, Cast iron body, Traditional screw mechanism.
strengths: Traditional English-pattern vise with decades of proven reliability in professional shops
Simple, robust mechanism with fewer parts to wear out over time
Wide jaws handle larger casework and panel clamping
limitations: No parallel guide, some racking on off-center clamping
Heavier to install than smaller vises

products.name: Eclipse Professional Tools EWVP6-NA Portable 6-Inch Woodworkers Vice
products.blurb: Key specs: Clamp-on design, No drilling required, Cast iron jaws.
strengths: Clamps onto any table or bench edge without drilling or permanent mounting
Genuinely portable between job sites or workbenches
Low price for occasional or mobile use
limitations: Much lower clamping force than a permanently mounted vise
Not suitable as a primary vise for daily hand-tool joinery
